title: How to Nail 'Tell Me About a Time' Every Time
description:
Stop Bombing Behavioural Questions | Answer "Tell Me About a Time" in 90 Seconds


Most interviews are won or lost on just 3 to 5 behavioural questions, and most candidates bomb them because they have no structure, not because their stories are bad. In this video I break down the exact 5-part CCARR framework I use with every candidate to answer "tell me about a time" and competency questions in 90 seconds flat, the 3 mistakes that quietly kill most people's answers, and the 1 closing sentence that tips the interviewer from "yeah, fine" to "I want this person on my team."

If you keep getting interview feedback like "lacked structure" or "didn't really land", this is the fix. You'll get the full framework, a real candidate's before and after word for word, and a practice drill to wire it in before your next interview.


What you'll learn in this video:
- The 5-part CCARR framework that structures any behavioural answer in 90 seconds
- What interviewers are actually testing when they ask "tell me about a time"
- The 3 mistakes that kill most answers, including the "we" trap almost everyone falls into
- The 1 reflection sentence 95% of candidates skip that signals seniority
- A 30-rep practice drill that makes the structure automatic under pressure
